---
name: create-skill-prompt
description: "Quick prompt to invoke the create-skill workflow agent in this repository."
---

Use this prompt to generate or update a `SKILL.md` template based on the current conversation and repository conventions.

Example usage:
- "Generate a SKILL.md for validating new feature branches in the monorepo."
- "Summarize the workflow for creating .instructions.md vs SKILL.md and save it."
